manuscript_campaign_scope: Recorded N-H, O-H and S-H histories in optimization/current/runs rank the complete 13,920-condition decision space per system.

candidate_space.role: representative source slices retained for diagnostics

initial_design: archived diagnostic draw of 12 source-slice rows without replacement; manuscript initial batches are recorded in optimization/current/runs
model: model/bo_core.py; standardized 116-dimensional categorical feature kernel (12 formulation identities, 8 solvent identities, and 96 formulation–solvent interactions); normal–inverse-gamma Bayesian linear regression. N–H formulations have a fixed Ag2SO4/PPh3 catalyst/ligand background, so their formulation identities correspond one-to-one to the original base/additive categories; O–H formulations include the specified Cu/Ni catalyst–base pair.
acquisition: representative-slice diagnostic: latent posterior mean + 1.96 * latent posterior SD; posterior updated between batches and held constant while selecting each batch of 12
model_input_boundary: Only previously selected experimental response labels enter the BO policy or stop monitor. The candidate library includes two author-requested known reference formulations; the remaining ten identities are sampled without inspecting their responses.

analysis_budget.actual_selected_counts: selections/plan_summary.json; stop earlier if the unchanged model rule is met

data_provenance: Original workbook bytes and the complete archived diagnostic exports are retained unchanged; manuscript campaign histories are deposited in optimization/current/runs.
